components.name: Autocomplete
components.description: Enable users to search and select from a filtered list of options as they type.

components.name: Button
components.description: Enable users to trigger actions by pressing a clickable element.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Allow users to select one or more options from a list of independent choices.

components.name: Currency
components.description: Collect and display monetary amounts with automatic currency formatting.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: Enable users to select a specific date through an interactive calendar interface.

components.name: DateRangePicker
components.description: Enable users to select a start and end date range through an interactive calendar.

components.name: DateTimePicker
components.description: Enable users to select a specific date and time through an interactive calendar interface.

components.name: ErrorMessage
components.description: Display error messages to users with prominent visual and semantic prominence.

components.name: FileUpload
components.description: Enable users to upload files with drag-and-drop support and validation.

components.name: Hidden
components.description: Store and submit form field values that should not be visible to users.

components.name: HtmlContent
components.description: Display sanitized HTML content safely within the application interface.

components.name: HtmlEditor
components.description: Enable users to create and format HTML content with a visual text editor toolbar.

components.name: IFrame
components.description: Secure-by-default sandbox policy. Supports the documented use cases (embedded video, maps, forms, third-party widgets) while keeping the frame isolated. `allow-same-origin` is deliberately omitted because combining it with `allow-scripts` would let the framed document script its way out of the sandbox.

components.name: Image
components.description: Display images with responsive sizing, fallback handling, and accessibility support.

components.name: Input
components.description: Collect single-line text and numeric input from users with validation and formatting support.

components.name: Link
components.description: Navigate users to a different page or external resource via a clickable text link.

components.name: Radio
components.description: Enable users to select exactly one option from a list of mutually exclusive choices.

components.name: Select
components.description: Enable users to select one or more options from a dropdown list with optional search.

components.name: Slider
components.description: Enable users to select a numeric value from a continuous range using a draggable control.

components.name: SpeechToTextTextarea
components.description: Enable users to enter text through voice input combined with traditional text editing.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Enable users to toggle a setting or feature on or off with a visual switch.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Collect multi-line text input from users with optional length limits and formatting.

components.name: TimePicker
components.description: Enable users to select a specific time through a time picker interface.

components.name: Tree
components.description: Display hierarchical data with expandable nodes and checkboxes for selection.
